title: This AI Stock CRUSHED Nvidia, Micron & Intel — 600%+ Rally Has Wall Street Watching! #Nlst #netlist
description:
One AI stock has delivered a jaw-dropping 600%+ gain in 2026, outperforming major semiconductor giants like Nvidia, Micron, SanDisk and Intel.
 
 
Meet Netlist — ticker symbol NLST. The company develops advanced memory and storage technology used in AI and data-center computing.

  The stock has gained 600%+ year to date, beating major semiconductor names like Nvidia, Micron, SanDisk, and Intel.

  One major catalyst is Netlist’s five-year licensing and supply agreement with Samsung.

💰 The numbers are impressive too. Q2 2026 revenue jumped 163% year over year to $109.8 million, while Netlist posted $1.4 million in net income, compared with a $6.1 million loss a year earlier.

What’s driving the rally?

 AI demand, advanced memory technology, and major business developments are putting this company in the spotlight.

But after such a massive run, can the stock keep climbing—or is a correction coming? 📈🤔

This video is for educational and informational purposes only, not financial advice.


And first-half sales reached $214.7 million, more than 3× the previous year.

 After a 600%+ rally, can Netlist keep climbing—or is the stock due for a pullback?
